title: Brazilian Banking Giant Itaú Formalizes Crypto Role as Brazil Closes Its Licensing Window
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Brazilian Banking Giant Itaú Formalizes Crypto Role as Brazil Closes Its Licensing Window Itaú has formally registered with Brazil’s central bank to intermediate and custody crypto assets under the new licensing rules. This post Brazilian Banking Giant Itaú Formalizes Crypto Role as Brazil Closes Its Licensing Window first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
